brief: A support tool triages refund requests. Policy: escalate to a human when the customer says the item never arrived despite a delivery record or alleges fraud or unauthorized use of their card. Otherwise deny refunds on digital goods. Otherwise approve when the request was made within 30 days of delivery and the item is unused or the customer describes a defect, and deny everything else.
input_shape: { delivered_on: string (YYYY-MM-DD), requested_on: string (YYYY-MM-DD), category: 'physical' | 'digital', message: string }
